character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Pixel art game asset sprite, full-body character portrait of Subject-Delta bio-mechanical apex predator boss, top-down tactical perspective. Grotesque quadrupedal monstrosity fused from hardened industrial steel plates and mutated organic muscle tissue. The main body resembles a hunched hound-like beast with exposed spine segments glowing with erratic orange data-pulses, capped with a heavy steel mandible structure instead of a natural jaw. Long metallic tendon whips trail from its hind quarters, and its front paws end in industrial hydraulic pile-driver spikes instead of claws. 90s retro anime bio-punk aesthetic, clean sharp pixel lines, gritty cyberpunk color palette, transparent background, isolated sprite, NO background elements, NO walls, NO ground.
